title: Software Engineer
teaser: We are currently hiring a Software Engineer to join our Ensoft team, contributing to the development of advanced networking software. You will work on cutting-edge projects from design to delivery, collaborating with a talented group of graduates. Ideal for those with a strong academic background and a passion for software development.
description:
Please note this posting is to advertise potential job opportunities. This exact role may not be open today but could open in the near future. When you apply, a Cisco representative may contact you directly if a relevant position opens.

Meet the Team  
Join Cisco’s Ensoft software development team to shape the future of networking.  We are responsible for creating cutting edge software that helps to run the Internet, delivered with outstanding quality.   
 
We offer an exceptional career path for talented individuals with an enthusiasm for software development.  Our team is entirely composed of people who arrived as young, exceptional graduates from top universities. The pathway is there to develop into any of the roles in the team, from the directors and management line to our industry-leading technical experts.   
 
Our office is in Harpenden, close to the station and with a very fast connection into London. Harpenden is an attractive town with a thriving centre of shops, bars and restaurants. Close by is the city of St Albans, bringing a wider social scene (theatres, clubs, a wider selection of bars) and all the facilities offered by a modern city.   
 
We have a really friendly culture.  It is a sign of how well people get on that employees arrange so many activities together in their spare time.  This is on top of the many company funded social events arranged by our social team including team celebrations, weekly five a side football, annual Christmas and Summer parties, and many other one-off events. 
  
We all love working here, but don't just take our word for it. The best way to judge is to see and hear what our employees think about us, so please take a look at our casebooks (https://cs.co/ensoft) and come along to our recruitment events to speak to us first hand. 
  
Your Impact  
 From the very start of your career you will be faced with the challenge of developing the very latest networking software – everything from the initial ideas and design through to code, test, delivery and support.   
 
You will contribute to Cisco’s flagship IOS XR network operating system, with opportunity to work on everything from low level build and install infrastructure up to higher level manageability and routing applications.   

Minimum Qualifications 

You must want a career developing software - that's what we do! 

The barrier to entry is high, so you need a proven academic capability.   This typically means you will have a numerate degree from a leading University and all A/A* grades at A-level or equivalent. 

Software experience is useful, but not essential.  It is great to find recent graduates who love writing code and want to turn that into a successful career. But we provide comprehensive training that means anyone with the right potential can excel; our primary criteria for recruiting are potential and enthusiasm rather than what you happen to already know. 

The software development process is collaborative, so you should enjoy working closely with the other people in your team. 

Oh, by the way, we believe that we are creating an exceptional team, so you need a pride and passion for your work and should expect to work with us for many years. 

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
